public_source: Rooney et al. (2026) SNAPSHOT USA 2024, Global Ecology and Biogeography, DOI 10.1111/geb.70229
source_location: public article PDF page 8/28 (zero-based PDF page 7), data cleaning methods
verified_statement: authors modified start/end dates in the deployment metadata file in R to match the dates of the first/last images in the sequences file
dryad_readme_label: Start_Date/End_Date described as camera placement/retrieval dates, but published cleaning documentation supersedes naive outcome-free interpretation
remedial_requirement: Obtain authentic original installation and removal logs or a genuinely prospectively designed new validation camera survey whose effort frame and sampling roster exist independently of species detections.
methodological_consequence: Date field labels are not reliable evidence that the archived values were unmodified by observation outcomes. Selecting camera sites on these fields is not a clean untouched-external design.
